def model(o):
    p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);T=fk(p[4:11]);C=np.array([[2**-.5,2**-.5,0],[2**-.5,-2**-.5,0],[0,0,-1]])
    Rc=np.array(o.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3];Rb=Rc@C.T@T[:3,:3].T
    tool=np.array([0,0,.2035]);root=p[26:29]-Rb@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@tool)
    return p,Rb,root,tool

def move(xyz,seconds=2,grip=None,rot=None):
    o=obs();p,Rb,root,tool=model(o);q=p[4:11].copy();T=fk(q)
    start=p[26:29];Rs=Rb@T[:3,:3]
    if rot is None:rot=Rs
    elif np.isscalar(rot):rot=R.from_euler('z',rot).as_matrix()@R.from_euler('x',np.pi).as_matrix()
    delta=R.from_matrix(rot@Rs.T).as_rotvec()
    a=p[29:42].copy();a[8:12]=0;a[12]=-1
    if grip is not None:a[7]=grip
    A=[]
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,int(seconds/.05)):
        s=t*t*(3-2*t);pos=start+(np.array(xyz)-start)*s;Rt=R.from_rotvec(delta*s).as_matrix()@Rs
        def err(qn):
            T=fk(qn);return np.r_[ (root+Rb@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@tool)-pos)*5, R.from_matrix((Rb@T[:3,:3])@Rt.T).as_rotvec(), (qn-q)*.003]
        sol=least_squares(err,q,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.07,-2.89,-.017,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.069,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=60);q=sol.x
        if np.linalg.norm(err(q)[:3])>.06:raise ValueError(('unreachable',pos,err(q)))
        a[:7]=q;A.append(a.copy())
    A.extend([a.copy()]*12)
    return run(A,'move')

def base(v,seconds=1,torso=0):
    p=current();a=p[29:42].copy();a[8:11]=v;a[11]=torso;a[12]=1
    A=np.tile(a,(int(seconds/.05),1));stop=a.copy();stop[8:12]=0
    return run(np.vstack([A,np.tile(stop,(10,1))]),'base')
PY

def cloud(path,cam):
    cam='robot0_'+cam if not cam.startswith('robot0_') else cam
    m=json.load(open(path+'/meta.json'));d=np.load(path+'/depth_'+cam+'.npy');d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
    c=m['cameras'][cam];T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']);K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);v,u=np.mgrid[:d.shape[0],:d.shape[1]]
    pts=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d,np.ones_like(d)],-1)@T.T
    pts[:,:,:3]+=T[:3,0]*.034
    return pts[:,:,:3]
